claims.statement: TONE3000 is a JUCE 9.0.3 audio plugin (VST3 / AU / CLAP / LV2 / Standalone) that loads Neural Amp Modeler (NAM) captures and impulse responses (IRs) plus a built-in effects suite (Delay/Chorus/Tremolo/Compressor/Reverb/Convolution). The UI is native JUCE (plugin/ui, namespace t3k::ui) — no browser engine; the React/webview build was retired (plugin/docs/native-ui.md). NAM (NeuralAmpModelerCore) and its DSP dependency AudioDSPTools are in-tree under plugin/, hand-populated — Dependencies/ trees are load-bearing.

Build configuration is read at CMake configure time from the repo-root .env (and .env.local override, with the configure environment overriding both). The CMake-side cloud vars are baked into the generated T3kConfig.h (plugin/ui/NativeUi.cmake, starting from core/T3kConfig.h.in): T3K_PUBLISHABLE_KEY (required, = t3k_pub_..., the OAuth client_id for sign-in); T3K_API_DOMAIN (default https://www.tone3000.com) and T3K_UPDATE_NOTICE (default off). A `.env` change requires a reconfigure. Since the win-standalone staging pass (2026-10-14) .env.example also documents the Windows staging/signing vars read by script/win-standalone.sh and script/signing/*.sh: T3K_TOOLCHAIN, T3K_STAGE_DIR (auto-detected /mnt/c/Users/*/Downloads when unset), T3K_SIGNING_DIR, T3K_SIGN (0/1), T3K_SIGN_CERT, T3K_SIGN_PASS, T3K_SIGN_TS (default http://timestamp.sectigo.com), T3K_SIGN_VERIFY; signing keys themselves stay machine-local (gitignored, outside the repo).

Root CMakeLists.txt declares the JUCE 9.0.3 project (C++20), adds the in-tree deps (JUCE via FetchContent, NeuralAmpModelerCore, AudioDSPTools, the googletest test dir), and — for MinGW Windows builds — carries TWO keep-protected patches: T3K_MINGW_DWRITE_CRP (DirectWrite CreateRectFontPalace workaround patch in JUCE) and T3K_MINGW_ASIO_SEH (ASIO SEH exception) — documented in docs/agents/windows-build.md; do not remove these lines.

UI iteration uses the standalone testbed app (plugin/ui/testbed, target UiTestbed) rendering PluginRoot on a fixture-driven MockBackend + MockSession; modes include --scenario (live window), --selftest (unit tests + focus policy in a real window), --capture (2x PNG per scenario), --compare (before/after diff), --bench (CPU/memory phases). It is the acceptance path for UI changes: a green DspTests run does not prove the UI links; verify UI changes in the testbed or a GUI plugin build. -DT3K_BUILD_UI_TESTBED=ON wires --selftest into ctest.

Per-repo rules for AI agents live in the repo-root AGENTS.md, an INDEX whose task-specific rules are in docs/agents/*.md: dsp-invariants.md (DSP engines), ui-wiring.md (params/knobs/chains), ir-reverb-training.md (reverb-vs-IR-reference protocol), audio-testing.md (the sonic MEASUREMENT protocol: click-index/jump metrics, comb & dropout laws, per-effect probe matrix, the hunt->measure->guard loop), windows-build.md (MinGW cross-build), linux-build-deep.md, merge-upstream.md, ui-snapshots.md (testbed/goldens). Per-mode DSP laws and every CONSIDERED & DECLINED item in dsp-invariants.md are user-eared contracts to preserve — never silently simplify a law back to a naive form. STANDING RULE (AGENTS.md hard-rules, added 2026-10-15 by user request): always MEASURE DSP changes sonically (probe/sweep tests in the real engine) before shipping — a metric ladder plus a user A/B beats an algebraic guess; the R2 Mod 'killed-the-clicks' decision (write-tau 80 ms) landed exactly this way. 2026-10-16 reverb-budget-quality-uplift pass (docs/tickets/reverb-budget-quality-uplift.md, now in docs/tickets/complete/): P0 pinned the per-mode CPU ceiling at 23 us/block@128 (Spring <= 46) in AGENTS.md + docs/agents/dsp-invariants.md; P1 built the six-mode baseline table vs reference IRs; P2 shipped Plate (1.15 lift / 0.965 ceiling), Room (kRoomWashRef 1.20), and Chamber (kChamberWashFrac 1.60) density uplifts, and DECLINED Spring/Hall/Digital in-family (P1 rows already inside/above their references); UI type chips renamed 140/RV1/DIG -> PLT/SPR/DAT.

Windows deliverables are cross-built with MinGW in WSL and staged into TONE3000-win-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS (run-timestamp folder only, no descriptive suffix, -2/-3 dedup) under a stage dir auto-detected from /mnt/c/Users/*/Downloads or set via T3K_STAGE_DIR in .env, by script/win-standalone.sh (the former scripts/win-standalone.sh, folded into script/ by the repo-organization reorg); ASIO is a hard dependency; the result is a self-contained PE32+ with no mingw shared-library dependencies (no libstdc++/libgcc/libwinpthread in the DLL import table), verified per docs/agents/windows-build.md. Optional Authenticode signing: with T3K_SIGN=1 in .env the staged exe is signed via osslsigncode from machine-local certs in T3K_SIGNING_DIR (keys never committed) and re-verified; the reusable scripts live in script/signing/.

AGENTS.md hard rules also carry the 2026-10-16 MIT-port license rule (added during reverb tuning, generalized in the T-DAT-001 pass): MIT-licensed or public-domain reference code IS portable - structure AND constants, with an attribution + license comment at the port site; order/arrangement is restructured to repo style (no verbatim transcription). GPL/copyleft references (e.g. GPL reverb nodes) stay spec/measurement REFERENCE only - NEVER copy code, constants, curves, or tuned numbers into the MIT codebase. Zero-latency applies to ALL ports regardless of license. The T-DAT-001 PLT engine (the DAT Dattorro tank: plugin/include/effects/reverb/Reverb.h declares the class; the processDat body + datApf live in effects/reverb/plate/plate_engine.h, pulled in by the thin wrapper effects/reverb/plate/types/Reverb_DAT.h — engine/wrapper split after the per-mode split; suite DatGuards in test/src/dat_probe_tests.cpp) follows the Dattorro plate algorithm (Dattorro 1997), modified and restructured to repo style.

The DSP test loop is ./script/test-dsp.sh [gtest-filter]: configure-if-needed -> cmake --build build --target DspTests -> running build/test/DspTests_artefacts/.../DspTests. The suite compiles the REAL plugin sources (not copies) against the fixtures in test/files/ (NAM A2 captures a2-amp-test.nam / a2-amp-cab-test.nam / a2-am-test-2.nam, cab-ir-test(-2).wav, reverb-ir-mono/stereo-test.wav, em240-gold-plate-5s.wav, syn20-amp-c1/c2.nam); from plugin/ui it pulls in core/Labels.cpp (KnobScale readout formatter), views/nodeview/NodeModel.cpp + model/ChainState.cpp (the node grid's read-side model, added by the 2026-10-18 node-view closeout), views/gallery/EffectParams.cpp (the shared paramsFor knob table, added by the node-view batch 2 for the per-knob strip readout tests), plus the theme tokens compiled inline by test/src/theme_palette_tests.cpp, so a green DspTests does NOT prove the UI links (verify with the GUI target, e.g. TONE3000_Standalone, or the testbed). The suite grows with features — a count is a LOWER-BOUND snapshot, never assert a stale total on a red run: 469 after the plate '140' final pass, 487 after the R2 thirteenth cut (2026-10-15), 503 / 73 suites after the 2026-10-16 reverb-budget-quality-uplift pass, 511 / 75 after the T-DAT-001 wave-3 closeout (2026-10-17), 512 / 75 after the 2026-10-14 swappable-theme palette test, 521 after the 2026-10-18 node-view closeout (9 new NodeModel tests), 530 / 78 after the node-view batch-2 closeout (7 StripKnob + 2 AddAtSlot tests), 552 / 80 after the m06828 batch (4 new ProcessorTest remove-in-place/AddAtSlot floor-only tests + the Conv Rev label pin, commit 72f48ea), 560 after the 2026-10-20 optimization-findings state-size pass (8 new StateSize tests in test/src/state_size_tests.cpp + the shared flag-aware blob parser test/src/StateSizeBlob.h, commits 728e144 + 9f34a3f), 584 after the 2026-10-21 mod-click closeout (2b04a71), and 604 after the Wave + Volume block pass (6813cb5: test/src/wave_tests.cpp 11 + test/src/volume_tests.cpp 9; node_model palette grew to 8 kinds). Also: the gtest silent-0 trap — a ',' filter list can run 0 tests with exit 0; always confirm the 'Running N tests' line.

Porting-license rule (reworded 2026-10-20, commit 89afb4e, into the two-lane form): the VERBATIM lane — MIT-licensed or public-domain reference code IS portable, structure AND constants, with an attribution + license comment at the port site, order/arrangement restructured to repo style (no verbatim transcription); the MEASURE-DON'T-COPY lane — RE'd binaries, copyleft (GPL/LGPL/AGPL), and unlicensed references stay oracle-only: over the full domain, fit a cheap per-sample family of OURS, pin named constants (3–4 sig figs), and assert with a PLAIN tolerance (e.g. 'within 0.3 dB') that names no reference; the origin lives only in research/. The detailed rule text now lives in the GLOBAL machine AGENTS.md (~/.pi/agent/AGENTS.md, uncommitted) and is no longer duplicated in the repo AGENTS.md, whose hard rules keep the ZERO-latency decision (all ports, no oversampling), the model/subtype permissive rule, the standing sonic-MEASURE rule, and the 2026-10-20 JUCE 9.0.3 API-trap list. Zero-latency applies to ALL ports regardless of license.

The chain is a left/right lane of blocks (ChainBlock: Nam, IR, Insert, Effect, each with a ChainSide), processed at a fixed 48 kHz base rate (plugin/include/ChainDomain.h, kChainBaseSampleRate = 48000.0) with the host rate re-sampled at the chain's boundary (Lanczos-12). Zero-latency (PDC) is a hard invariant; the NAM engine and the reverb/convolver run inside the chain (convDry and, since the 2026-10-13 R1 pass, reverbDry are chain-layer dry-gain fields on the Convolution and Reverb effect blocks respectively). After the repo-organization reorg the effect engines live per-effect under plugin/include/effects/, each a HOST class header that pulls in its per-mode engine bodies via #include at the file end (single-engine effects are just the one header), plus thin mode/subtype wrappers: delay/Delay.h, chorus/Chorus.h, tremolo/Tremolo.h, wave/Wave.h (440 Hz tone generator, 5 shapes) and volume/Volume.h (±24 dB gain, 6813cb5) are single-engine; the reverb host at effects/reverb/Reverb.h has one engine header per mode family (digital/comb_engine.h, digital/Reverb_Plate.h legacy comb-plate arm, plate/plate_engine.h DAT Dattorro tank + datApf, spring/Reverb_Spring.h, room/Reverb_Room.h, chamber/Reverb_Chamber.h, hall/Reverb_Hall.h, shared/Reverb_SharedMod.h) plus thin type wrappers at digital/types/Reverb_DIG.h and plate/types/Reverb_DAT.h; the compressor host at effects/compressor/Compressor.h has one engine header per mode family (vca/tube/opto/fet/varimu) plus thin type wrappers at <mode>/types/Compressor_<Mode>.h (commit 3ffb35b, mirroring the reverb engine/wrapper split; the per-block compType field selects the mode's sub-type, 1 per mode today); and the convolver at effects/conv/ConvolutionReverb.h — which since the 2026-10-21 mod-v2 + tap-smoothing passes (9a5c3c8/9c203cb/2b04a71, superseding the 44a78ea kModWriteTauMs = 80.0 ms one-pole on the wet RING WRITE) soft-clamps the ADDED mod layer only: the ring write is RAW again (`wr[w] = wet[i]`, write before taps read) and the LFO-voiced tap sum gets TWO layer-only protections: a one-pole lowpass on the layer SUM (ConvolutionReverb.cpp:832) with kModTapTauMs = 5.0 at ConvolutionReverb.h:189 (the 2b04a71 fix for the user-audible L/R-alternating click — the wobbled taps re-emit transient edges; 5 ms shaves none of the ~32 Hz-corner 1 Hz body), then a tanh clip at the add step (`wet[i] += cl*tanh(lay/cl)`, cpp:837-838) with kModClipScale = 1e-1 at ConvolutionReverb.h:179 (1e-2 left 97–99 % of the steady layer inside the tanh knee at full mod + 18 dB dwell — the periodic click; 1e-1 measures 0 % clamped, jump-RMS 0.26× the raw layer, crest 3.08→2.23); setModClipScaleForTest(double) at h:337 (<0 = linear bit-exact anchor, 0 = ship default, >0 = explicit), modTapTauForTest() at h:339, and zeroModStageForTest() at h:343 (shared-baseline law-test reset) drive the ModLayerClipClickHunt + ModLoudDriveLaw + ModTapSmoothingLaw + TwoFreshEnginesSameModLayer tests. Both Wave and Volume engines follow the restore-funnel law: prepare(sampleRate) is idempotent and must NOT reset the engine state — the processor restore path runs setParams THEN prepareBlockForChainRate→prepare(). The wet-path one-pole τ remains banned from feedback-loop feeds (AGENTS.md hard rule). The UI build (NativeUi.cmake) adds ALL per-effect dirs (including effects/wave and effects/volume) to its include path so ChainBlock.h's bare engine includes resolve. LANE-LENGTH NOTE (m06828 batch, commit 72f48ea): the baseline-lane-length comment at ChainBlock.h:76-88 is now FLOOR-ONLY — alignBranchLaneLengths pads short lanes up to the baseline (insertCount == max(kMinLaneSlots - toneCount, 1)) but never trims a lane that grew past it (the node view's lazy insert padding can legally grow a lane to the full 20-slot grid size; a branch lane is the only lane still trimmed, ProcessorChain.cpp trimLaneToBaseline), and removeChainBlock leaves an insert gap in place rather than left-shifting. PER-CALLBACK RENDER NOTE (optimization-findings Stage 5, commit 8f6d868): the three per-callback full-lane scans in processChainOnBuffer (the lastNamIndex sweep, the multi-core laneHasWork check, the setSpreadLane lane-stamp sweep) are now memoised in Processor.h's LaneScheduleCache / lastSpreadLane, invalidated by the single chainRevision funnel (bumpChainRevision), so chain-unchanged callbacks pay no scan cost; BudgetConvolver's zero-caller message-thread primeSilence warm-up was deleted in the same pass.
